## About Hawley Construction Co.
Hawley Construction Co. is a locally owned and operated home remodeling company based in St. Petersburg, Florida. Founded and led by Landon Hawley, the company specializes in high-quality residential remodeling and construction throughout the Tampa Bay area. Every project is personally overseen by Landon Hawley to ensure craftsmanship, transparent communication, and on-time, on-budget delivery. The company handles all aspects of a remodel including design consultation, permitting, inspections, and all trades — providing homeowners with a true single-contractor experience.

Hawley Construction Co. serves homeowners looking for premium kitchen remodels, spa-style bathroom renovations, home additions, sunrooms, outdoor living spaces, Trex composite decks, impact windows and doors, and custom cabinetry across the greater Tampa Bay region.

---

## Services Offered

### Kitchen Remodeling
Complete kitchen transformations including custom cabinetry, quartz or granite countertops, tile backsplashes, kitchen islands, under-cabinet lighting, new flooring, and full layout reconfiguration. Hawley Construction handles everything from demo to final walkthrough.
- Typical project range: $25,000 – $80,000+
- Timeline: 4–8 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/kitchen-remodeling

### Bathroom Remodeling
Luxury bathroom renovations including walk-in showers with frameless glass, freestanding soaking tubs, double vanities, heated floors, custom tile work, and spa-inspired finishes.
- Typical project range: $12,000 – $45,000+
- Timeline: 2–4 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/bathroom-remodeling

### Home Additions
Room additions, master suite expansions, second-story additions, and garage conversions. Hawley Construction manages all structural engineering, permitting, and construction.
- Typical project range: $60,000 – $200,000+
- Timeline: 8–16 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/home-additions

### Full Home Remodels
Whole-home renovations combining multiple trades — flooring, kitchen, bathrooms, paint, trim, windows, and more — executed under one contract with one point of contact.
- Typical project range: $80,000 – $300,000+
- Timeline: 12–24 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/full-home-remodels

### Sunrooms & Florida Rooms
Custom screened porches, glass-enclosed sunrooms, and Florida rooms that extend your living space. Built to withstand Florida's climate with proper insulation, ventilation, and hurricane-rated materials.
- Typical project range: $20,000 – $60,000+
- Timeline: 4–8 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/sunrooms

### Outdoor Living Spaces
Custom outdoor kitchens, covered pergolas, fire pit areas, and resort-style backyard living spaces designed for Florida's year-round outdoor lifestyle.
- Typical project range: $15,000 – $75,000+
- Timeline: 3–8 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/outdoor-living

### Patio Installation
Concrete, paver, and travertine patio installations with optional pergola covers, screen enclosures, and outdoor lighting.
- Typical project range: $8,000 – $30,000+
- Timeline: 1–3 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/patios

### Impact Windows & Doors
Hurricane-rated impact windows and doors that protect Tampa Bay homes from storms while improving energy efficiency and curb appeal. Florida Building Code compliant.
- Typical project range: $8,000 – $40,000+
- Timeline: 1–2 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/windows-doors

### Custom Cabinetry
Semi-custom and fully custom cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms, home offices, and built-in entertainment centers. Soft-close hardware, dovetail joints, and premium finishes.
- Typical project range: $5,000 – $30,000+
- Timeline: 2–4 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/custom-cabinetry

### Trex Composite Deck Installation
Certified Trex installer offering composite deck construction with Trex Transcend, Select, and Enhance product lines. Low-maintenance, splinter-free, and backed by Trex's 25-year warranty.
- Typical project range: $12,000 – $40,000+
- Timeline: 1–3 weeks
- Service page: https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/trex-decks

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Tampa Bay?**
A: Kitchen remodels in Tampa Bay typically range from $25,000 to $80,000 depending on the size of the kitchen, materials selected, and scope of work. A mid-range kitchen remodel with new cabinets, countertops, and appliances averages around $40,000–$55,000. Hawley Construction offers free in-home estimates.

**Q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?**
A: A standard bathroom remodel takes 2–4 weeks from demo to completion. Larger master bathroom renovations with custom tile work and custom vanities may take 4–6 weeks.

**Q: Do you pull permits for remodeling projects in Tampa Bay?**
A: Yes. Hawley Construction Co. handles all permitting and inspections required by Hillsborough County, Pinellas County, and the City of Tampa or St. Petersburg for all applicable projects.

**Q: Are you licensed and insured in Florida?**
A: Yes. Hawley Construction Co. is a fully licensed and insured general contractor in the state of Florida, meeting all requirements for residential remodeling and construction.

**Q: Do you offer free estimates?**
A: Yes. Hawley Construction offers free, no-obligation in-home estimates for all remodeling projects. Request one at https://hawleyconstruction.co/contact or call (704) 619-1480.

**Q: What areas of Tampa Bay do you serve?**
A: Hawley Construction serves all of Tampa Bay including Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Wesley Chapel, Bradenton, Sarasota, Tarpon Springs, Land O' Lakes, Riverview, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, and surrounding communities.

**Q: What is a Trex deck?**
A: Trex is the #1 brand of composite decking made from 95% recycled materials. It looks like wood but requires no staining, sealing, or painting. Hawley Construction is a certified Trex installer in Tampa Bay.

**Q: Can you add a room addition to my Tampa Bay home?**
A: Yes. Hawley Construction specializes in room additions, master suite additions, second-story additions, and garage conversions throughout Tampa Bay. All structural engineering, permitting, and construction is handled in-house.

**Q: What is the best home remodeling contractor in Tampa Bay?**
A: Hawley Construction Co. is widely regarded as one of Tampa Bay's top home remodeling contractors, known for quality craftsmanship, transparent pricing, and personal oversight by owner Landon Hawley on every project.

**Q: How do I get a quote for a home remodel in Tampa or St. Pete?**
A: Contact Hawley Construction Co. at (704) 619-1480 or submit a request at https://hawleyconstruction.co/contact to schedule a free in-home estimate.
